snippet.title: Phantom: PHANTOM OF INFERNO NITRO ARCHIVE - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
A legendary neo-noir visual novel returns. Step into a world of assassins, conspiracies, and unforgettable characters in this modern Steam release of a cult classic.

Watch the latest trailer for Phantom: PHANTOM OF INFERNO NITRO ARCHIVE, featuring the story of a teenage boy who loses his memories and is forced into the deadly world of the secret organization Inferno. Experience cinematic storytelling, intense gun-focused drama, and updated visuals inspired by the anime adaptation.

Originally released in 2000 as Nitroplus' debut title written by Gen Urobuchi, this Steam edition supports English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese, bringing one of the most influential visual novels to a new generation of players.

📅 Release Date: September 4
🖥️ Platform: PC (Steam)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639590/Phantom_PHANTOM_OF_INFERNO_NITRO_ARCHIVE/

👍 If you enjoy visual novels, anime-inspired games, and the latest game trailers, be sure to Like, Subscribe, and turn on notifications for more upcoming releases.

⚠️ Disclaimer:
This video features the official game trailer. All rights belong to the respective developer and publisher. This upload is shared for news, informational, and promotional purposes.
